css: #work-modal,#handoff{box-sizing:border-box;max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;background-color:#fafbf9;color:#17233b;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:12px;padding:20px;width:min(92vw,680px);margin:auto}#work-modal::backdrop,#handoff::backdrop{background:rgba(23,35,59,0.55)}#work-modal.is-search .flow-detail,#work-modal.is-search .flow-actions{display:none!important}.flow-detail{margin-top:16px;min-width:0}.flow-detail-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;min-width:0}@media(min-width:640px){.flow-detail-grid{flex-direction:row;align-items:flex-start}}.flow-detail-media{flex:1 1 240px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.flow-detail-img{width:100%;height:200px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;display:block;background-color:#e2e8f0}.flow-badge{font-size:.75rem;color:#475569;background:#e2e8f0;padding:4px ease}.flow-btn-primary:focus-visible,.flow-btn-neutral:focus-visible,.flow-btn-remove:focus-visible,.flow-select:focus-visible,.flow-radio-input:focus-visible,.flow-pre:focus-visible{outline:2px solid 12px;border:1px solid
